name: Enni
found: The Ash-House by the western woods, tracing stories in the hearth-ash.
appearance: Old, near-blind eyes, ash-grey shawl, knucklebones in a bag at her hip.
sayings: Ask me what I know, not what I'll tell you.
wants: One last heir who will listen.
does_not_want: The village forgetting the gods' silence.
dreams: That the hearth-fires speak again. It would be a bad thing.
oddly_also: Takes food and trinkets from villagers who fear her, without comment.
knows: Which charms still work against the dead.
offers: Healing, charms; friends and identify, for a price.
family: A few distant kin; one loyal servant, Medam.
tragedies: Has watched the old knowledge dwindle to almost nothing in her lifetime.
